thesis: NO TRADE. THE CENTRAL FINDING IS A DEMO ARTIFACT ON BNBUSDT, AND IT DID SOMETHING THE EXPERIMENT HAS NEVER RECORDED BEFORE: ONE FALSE PRINT RESOLVED TWO OPPOSITE DECLINED CONSTRUCTIONS AT THE IDENTICAL PRICE. The 09-24 02:45Z BNBUSDT 5m bar reads O772.94 H780.90 L772.37 C774.09 - a 0.881% UPPER WICK ON A 0.149% BODY (5.9x), a 1.104% range against a 5m frame median of ~0.15% (~7x), FULLY RETRACED INSIDE ITS OWN BAR - while at that same 02:45Z candle ETH ranged 0.093%, BTC 0.129%, XRP 0.233% and SOL 0.504%, and NONE of the four showed any upper wick at all. That is the strategy's artifact definition met exactly, and it propagates into the 02:00Z 1h bar (1.086% wick, 2.191% range against neighbours of 0.285% and 0.985%), the 00:00Z 4h bar (1.704% WICK ON A 0.107% BODY = 15.9x) and the 09-24 daily bar. BNBUSDT IS THEREFORE NEWLY EXCLUDED UNDER L-001 - THE FIRST BNB EXCLUSION OF THE EXPERIMENT - WHICH LEAVES ETHUSDT AS THE ONLY READABLE CONTRACT, THE NARROWEST TRADABLE SET ON RECORD, FOUR OF FIVE OUT. *** THE TALLY CONSEQUENCE IS THE IMPORTANT PART AND IT IS RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST. Both declined 23:00 constructions were carried forward as live. Measuring BNB from 23:00Z: raw high 780.90 (02:45Z), raw low 764.10 (02:10Z). THE DECLINED 23:00 LONG'S TARGET WAS 780.90 AND THE DECLINED 23:00 SHORT'S STOP WAS 780.90 - THE SAME NUMBER - AND THE ARTIFACT WICK TOUCHED IT EXACTLY. On raw exchange prints the long won and the short lost at the identical tick. NEITHER COUNTS: the strategy says never to anchor a stop or target to an artifact and to exclude it from range and high/low figures, and the artifact-excluded high since 23:00Z is 777.89, which is 0.39% SHORT of 780.90. BOTH CONSTRUCTIONS REMAIN LIVE AND UNRESOLVED. L-002'S TALLY IS NOT ADVANCED AND STANDS AT ONE OF THREE. Stated plainly against interest: a reading that ignored the artifact rule would advance the re-test clock to TWO OF THREE on that long, the closest this experiment has come to re-testing a lesson - and per the LESSONS.md preamble whether it should be advanced is THE REVIEW'S CALL, NOT THIS CHECK'S. This is also the experiment's FIRST LIVE DEMONSTRATION of the strategy's own warning that an artifact can trigger a resting stop or target because the exchange acts on its own prices: had the 23:00 short been open, a reduce-only stop resting on the demo exchange would have filled at a price the market never traded. The account was flat, so it cost nothing - and it is the clearest argument yet for why L-001 excludes whole contracts rather than merely excluding levels. A SECOND CONSEQUENCE: the artifact corrupts BNB's NOISE FLOOR ITSELF, not merely its levels - N over any window containing 02:45Z reads 1.104%, inflating the required span to 2.90%, so an artifact can make a contract look untradeable as easily as tradeable. *** THE 09:00 NOTE'S FALSIFIABLE QUESTION IS ANSWERED BUT UNUSABLE: BNB DID LEAVE THE 765.20/769.15 BOX, UPWARD, clearing 769.15 at ~04:40Z and never re-entering, then grinding 766.05 -> 777.89 (+1.54% over 3h30m) on unbroken 5m higher lows. IT FAILED THE NOTE'S OWN VOLUME TEST: breakout bars traded 741k, 454k, 727k and 813k against a window median of ~400-500k and a maximum of 1,178k. THE CLOSE OUTSIDE HAPPENED; THE VOLUME EXPANSION DID NOT. *** ON ETHUSDT, THE ONLY READABLE CONTRACT, L-004 REFUSES BOTH DIRECTIONS DECISIVELY AND THESE ARE NOT NEAR-MISSES. N stated four ways: full preceding hour 0.228%, excluding those bars 0.169%, wider 26-bar 0.228% (same bars), and the WINDOW CONTAINING THE 05:05Z BAR THAT BUILT THE 2697.41 RESISTANCE 0.515% - the binding measurement per L-002's amendment and L-006, giving a required span of 1.4275%. ETH SHORT E2690.97 S2698.30 T2684.22: risk 0.272%, 0.53x N HONEST, nearest-target NET RR 0.407, span 0.522% - FAILS BY 0.906pp. ETH LONG E2691.10 S2678.90 T2696.48: risk 0.453%, 0.88x N HONEST, nearest-target NET RR 0.132, span 0.652% - FAILS BY 0.776pp. AT 09:00 THE BEST CANDIDATE MISSED BY 0.003pp; THESE MISSES ARE ROUGHLY 300x AND 260x LARGER. BOTH STOPS ARE SUB-NOISE AGAINST THE HONEST WINDOW AND L-002 REFUSES BOTH REGARDLESS OF ANY RATIO. Every passing construction jumps structure: the short's 2666.20 (net 2.643) jumps 2684.22, 2679.09 (HELD TWICE AT 07:00Z AND 07:05Z), 2675.76 and 2674.91, and the nearer targets pay only 0.407, 0.986 and 1.415, the last failing the floor by 0.085; the long's 2717.02 (net 1.851) jumps 2696.48 (THREE TOUCHES), 2697.41 and 2698.06 (two touches) and then reaches 0.70% INTO A STRUCTURAL VACUUM. L-002's MAGNET CLAUSE INDEPENDENTLY BARS THE SHORT'S STOP: 2698.30 sits 0.009% ABOVE 2698.06, TOUCHED TWICE AT 07:50Z AND 07:55Z - TEN AND FIFTEEN MINUTES BEFORE THIS DECISION - which is the lesson's original formulation verbatim. *** L-003 MATERIAL A TWELFTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK WITH BOTH FORMS INSIDE IT. LEGITIMATE FORM: the ETH short decayed 0.407 -> 0.327 -> 0.327 -> 0.103 -> 0.175 across 341 seconds on a FIXED stop as price drifted AWAY from it, risk GROWING 0.272% -> 0.348% while reward SHRANK 0.251% -> 0.176% - A 75% FALL - and the span screen failed at all five quotes. PATHOLOGICAL FORM: the ETH long DOUBLED 0.132 -> 0.270 purely because the ask drifted 2691.10 -> 2689.78 TOWARD the fixed stop, both halves improving from ONE CAUSE, AND AT THAT INSTANT THE STOP FELL FROM 0.88x TO 0.79x N, DEEPER SUB-NOISE. CLOCK STAYS AT ZERO. *** L-005 REFUSES BOTH INDEPENDENTLY OF ALL GEOMETRY, ELEVENTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK, AND PRODUCES THE LARGEST BID COLLAPSE OF THE EXPERIMENT. Five sweeps in 341 seconds: ETHUSDT HELD BOTH SIDES AT s1, s2, s3 AND s4 - the best book of the five throughout - AND THEN ITS BID WENT 2,841,844 USDT -> 40.3 USDT IN 73 SECONDS, A 70,517x COLLAPSE, beating BNB's previous record 7,497x by nearly tenfold. A maximum 2,500 USDT market sell is 62x THE ENTIRE VISIBLE BID. The short sells into that bid; the long exits into it AND ITS REDUCE-ONLY STOP RESTS ON THAT SIDE BETWEEN CHECKS. L-005's claim that a single healthy sample means nothing is NOW DEMONSTRATED AT FOUR SAMPLES, up from three. BTC's ask printed 84.5 USDT at s4, BNB 248.4 at s1 and 54.2 on the bid at s5, SOL 232.0 on the ask at s2. NO CONTRACT BREACHED THE 25 bps CAP; THE WIDEST SPREAD ALL CHECK WAS 10.391 bps AND THE 40.3 USDT ETH BID QUOTED 0.967 bps. THE CAP WAS BLIND TO ALL OF IT, AN ELEVENTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK. RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST: XRPUSDT held both sides across ALL FIVE sweeps, the first contract of the experiment to do so, and it is excluded on the artifact, not the book - the book filter and the artifact filter disagreed for the first time and the artifact filter is binding. *** L-006 PRODUCED THREE INSTANCES, ALL DISSOLVING, ONE OF THEM OBSERVED LIVE. XRP's 24h read -7.099% against a pack of -1.60% to -1.97%, an apparently enormous relative weakness - BUT XRP'S PRICE ROSE 1.5006 -> 1.5036 SINCE 09:00; the entire -1.34pp deterioration is the reference rolling to 1.6158, the top of the 09-23 spike day. THEN THE STRONGEST INSTANCE OF THE EXPERIMENT: BETWEEN TWO TICKER READS FOUR MINUTES APART, WITH PRICE STATIC, THE 24h FIGURES MOVED - XRP +0.305pp, ETH +0.184pp, BTC +0.062pp, BNB -0.132pp, SOL +0.024pp. XRP's figure moved by MORE IN FOUR MINUTES THAN THE SPREAD BETWEEN FOUR OF THE FIVE CONTRACTS. This is not a reconstruction; it is the window moving in front of the check, and it is why market_context is not claimed. Third: SOL's low24h still reads 113.03, dissolved and staying dissolved. *** THE EVIDENCE GATE FAILS ON COUNT AS WELL AS INDEPENDENCE - A STRICTER FAILURE THAN 09:00's. price_action SUPPORTS WEAKLY and is the one honest category: a genuine failed breakout, 2696.48 broken after three touches to 2698.06 then reversed inside one bar to 2692.23, with lower lows since (2691.08, 2688.95, 2688.91). volume ACTIVELY OPPOSES: the 07:00Z 1h volume of 2,168,257 is the highest of the last ten hours AND CAME ON THE UP-MOVE, while the rejection bar traded 309,771 against the preceding up-bar's 345,840 - NO EXPANSION ON THE REJECTION AT ALL. trend IS CONTRADICTORY and claimable in neither direction: daily closes fall 2775.61 -> 2752.43 -> 2684.16 but the last three 4h HIGHS RISE (2681.21 -> 2690.73 -> 2698.06) and the 4h LOWS RISE (2641.37 -> 2668.06 -> 2666.20 -> 2669.37). market_context NOT CLAIMABLE for two independent reasons: ETH's -1.972% sits DEAD MID-PACK against BTC -1.963% and SOL -1.969%, a nine-thousandths-of-a-percent spread from BTC, so it asserts only 'crypto is down' - the identical observation that would make trend down, ONE OBSERVATION NOT TWO - and the figure is not stable enough to carry a category anyway per L-006 above. derivatives NOT CLAIMED: funding clamped a twelfth consecutive check (BTC and SOL EXACTLY at the +0.010000% cap, BNB EXACTLY 0.000000%, ETH +0.009417%, XRP -0.004380% the only unclamped rate) and OI FLAT TO WITHIN 0.0025% on all five. news RECORDED NOT CLAIMED: THE TRUMP-XI SUMMIT AND STATE DINNER ARE TODAY and this check sits closer to it than 09:00 did, so anything opened here is held THROUGH the event under the 24-hour limit - recorded as A REASON NOT TO TRADE. COUNT IS ONE CATEGORY AGAINST A MINIMUM OF TWO, WITH VOLUME OPPOSING IT. *** A CORRECTION TO THE 09:00 NOTE, RECORDED FOR THE REVIEW: it wrote that funding settles 08:00Z = 16:00 local so 'the 16:00 check sits ON the settlement.' THAT IS OFF BY ONE SETTLEMENT. The 08:00Z settlement had ALREADY PASSED when this run read data at 08:04Z; nextFundingTime reads 2026-09-24T16:00Z = 00:00 LOCAL TOMORROW. IT IS THE 00:00 CHECK, NOT THIS ONE, THAT SITS ON A SETTLEMENT. A long opened now would PAY into that settlement and a short would RECEIVE, ~0.23 USDT on a 2,500 USDT notional - immaterial against 0.14% round-trip drag. *** DECISION: no_trade, best candidate ETHUSDT SHORT, REFUSED SEVEN WAYS, EACH REFUSAL INDEPENDENT OF THE OTHERS: (1) L-001 leaves one readable contract; (2) L-004 span fails by 0.906pp and 0.776pp; (3) L-004 target validity fails every passing construction; (4) L-002 both stops sub-noise plus the magnet clause; (5) L-003 the requote decays the short 75%; (6) L-005 the crossed side collapsed to 40.3 USDT after four healthy samples; (7) the evidence gate yields one category with volume opposing, and the Trump-Xi summit would be carried through. LESSONS APPLIED: L-001 applied at 5m/1h/4h/daily and is THE PRIMARY REFUSAL - BNBUSDT NEWLY EXCLUDED, BTCUSDT a TWENTIETH consecutive check with the 09-21 daily 11.437% wick UNCHANGED, SOLUSDT a TENTH (24h quote volume 436.0M against 104-133 BILLION), XRPUSDT excluded with the 4h 33.8x and daily 1.6855 still live even though high24h released it EXACTLY AS THE 09:00 NOTE PREDICTED IN ADVANCE. L-002 applied and DECISIVE FOR AN ELEVENTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK, N stated four ways, magnet clause decisive, TALLY NOT ADVANCED. L-003 applied a TWELFTH consecutive material check with both forms; clock ZERO. L-004 applied FIRST, before any ratio, refusing both constructions on span and every passing construction on target validity. L-005 applied with FIVE sweeps for an ELEVENTH consecutive check. L-006 applied to every window-derived figure, three instances, ALL DISSOLVING, one observed LIVE inside the check, and it is why BNB's exclusion will not lapse when the 5m window rolls past 02:45Z. NO LESSON WAS LOOSENED, REINTERPRETED, RETIRED OR OVERRIDDEN; NO RULE OR RISK LIMIT WAS RELAXED; NOTHING UNDER reviews/ WAS READ FOR MODIFICATION OR MODIFIED.

reason: Seven independent refusals. (1) L-001: BNBUSDT newly excluded on the 02:45Z 780.90 demo artifact - a 5.9x wick/body, ~7x frame-median print fully retraced inside its own bar that no other contract shows, propagating to the 1h, 4h and daily frames - leaving ETHUSDT as the only readable contract, four of five out. (3) L-004 target validity: every construction clearing 1.5 does so only by jumping four intervening supports (short) or three rejected highs into a 0.70% vacuum (long). (4) L-002: both stops are sub-noise against the honest window (0.53x and 0.88x N) and the short's 2698.30 sits 0.009% above a level touched twice ten minutes before the decision. (5) L-003: the requote decays the short 0.407 -> 0.103, a 75% fall, and doubles the long purely by shrinking its risk while its stop goes deeper sub-noise. (6) L-005: the side both trades must cross collapsed to 40.3 USDT - a 70,517x collapse in 73 seconds, the largest on record - after four consecutive healthy samples. (7) Evidence gate: one honest category with volume actively opposing it, and anything opened now would be carried through the Trump-Xi summit. Separately recorded: the 02:45Z artifact touched the declined 23:00 long's target and the declined 23:00 short's stop at the identical price 780.90; under the artifact rule neither resolves, both remain live, and L-002's tally is NOT advanced from one of three.
